foundations: the canonical Action chain has tenant-scoped Proposal, Approval, ExecutionLease, immutable initial Receipt, unknown without blind retry, provider reread reconcile and compensation Proposal foundations
generic execution revalidates ActionType revision, markings, approval quorum, expiry, risk and kill switches before leasing and refuses an unregistered adapter
the generic frontend distinguishes approved, leased, executing, applied, failed, unknown and reconciled and disables disconnected writes
the reviewed customer target contract separates side-effect-free Batch prepare and freeze in W6-07 from explicit start, contact resolution and channel Action in W6-08

findings.finding: W6-07 remains unchecked and has no frozen CustomerDialogueBatch, Segment, Journey, Dialogue or Consent authority, so W6-08 has no valid eligible item set to start.
no versioned customer message, service follow-up, care, recommendation or opt-out Action/Draft types are declared; ecommerce.customer permissions.actionTypes is empty.
no batch-level explicit start command, expected-version CAS, frozen-item hash verification, per-item Action creation Receipt, start idempotency key or zero-implicit-start invariant exists.

generic acquire and execute do not resolve or bind Consent/Preference revisions and do not revalidate withdrawal immediately before provider invocation; there is no ordering authority for start versus consent revocation, so the race cannot fail closed.

generic guardrails count executions by ActionType and minute/day, but no exact customer, channel, journey, campaign and rolling-window frequency policy, quiet-hours rule, prior-touchpoint query or reservation/settlement authority exists.

no ProtectedContactRef authority or trusted contact resolver keeps destinations outside Workshop payloads and resolves them only after current consent and account checks; current generic adapter receives the Proposal payload directly.

no exact joint binding ties CustomerDialogueBatch item, Customer ref, Consent/frequency snapshots, Journey/Dialogue strategy, channel account, capability, budget and ImpactPreview to Proposal, Approval and Lease.

the production ActionAdapter registry has no typed customer channel adapter and no trusted account, contact-ref input schema, dry validation, provider idempotency, usage, webhook, unsubscribe, partial or conformance contract.

the generic executor commits Lease consumption and proposal executing before provider invocation, retaining a crash-without-Receipt window; this can neither prove no-send nor safely decide whether a customer may be contacted again.

no item-level start reducer, immutable item attempt, eligible-to-terminal conservation, cancellation rule or partial aggregate exists; a batch cannot expose sent, accepted, failed, unknown, skipped-after-withdrawal and reconciled counts independently.

generic resolved provider outcome remains embedded in reconcile payload, manual Case is absent and no signed delivery/unsubscribe/complaint webhook or ordering reducer updates Touchpoint and Consent authorities without duplicate send.

only the generic Draft Inbox and common Workshop shell exist; no customer-specific start confirmation, frequency/consent disclosure, withdrawal race, per-item partial timeline, unknown/reconcile or protected-contact intervention UI is implemented.

W5-00 through W5-08 and W6-07 are unchecked, production adapter registrations remain zero and the P08/privacy baseline is not GREEN; no customer external capability is code-green or operational-ready.

verification.interpretation: generic single-action safety and UI foundations are stable, while customer batch start, consent race control, per-customer frequency, protected contact resolution, typed adapters and item-level partial state are absent
